# Summary

## Change classification

- [ ] G0 — Editorial
- [ ] G1 — Routine
- [ ] G2 — Material
- [ ] G3 — High risk

## Governance checks

- [ ] The change complies with the effective Governance Constitution.
- [ ] No alternate path bypasses governance, security, audit, or user-rights controls.
- [ ] Required owner and approver metadata is present.
- [ ] New or changed data has an approved purpose and privacy record, or no data is involved.
- [ ] Feature flags cannot disable protected controls.
- [ ] Documentation and architecture decisions are updated.

## Verification

List commands and results, or explain why this documentation-only change has no executable checks.

## Risk and rollback

Describe failure modes, monitoring, rollback, and any accepted residual risk.

## Release approval

- [ ] Independent technical review recorded where required.
- [ ] Release Authority approval recorded.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, health data, or sensitive logs are included.
